      "observations": [
        "Full owned88-line two-path diff read. Chat connection-error observer and message delivery exit processing remove duplicated16-name errorCodeString lists. Both keep isNSSErrorCode on the numeric NSS code, convert via getXPCOMFromNSSError and pass the converted result to nsINSSErrorsService.isErrorOverridable. This is an API/input-domain delegation, not proof that the underlying service preserves exactly the old list or permits every certificate failure.",
        "Chat observer first updates observed account row. Optional securityInfo access is on initial isNSSErrorCode argument; short-circuit then uses required securityInfo.errorCode for conversion. Exact API handling of undefined is outside paired comm evidence, so no broad missing-securityInfo safety claim. It calls addException without awaiting. Actual addException chooses selectedItem.account, guards missing connectionTarget, supplies location/securityInfo to exception dialog, awaits close via observer, removes observer on close and reconnects only if params.exceptionAdded. Classification does not itself add a certificate exception or reconnect.",
        "Compose initializes isNSSError/isOverridable false only on unsuccessful delivery. Truthy secInfo.errorCode and numeric NSS classification are required before converting exitCode and asking overridability. Failure formatting/notifyListenerOnStopSending/fail remain before conditional transport-security notification. Successful delivery follows separate news/mail/Fcc path. sendDeliveryCallback awaits exit processing; this patch is not a delivery retry or accepted-certificate guarantee.",
        "Manual style: service variable names express the actual XPCOM receiver; removal of string-list duplication leaves policy ownership outside comm. Complex multiline service acquisition and condition remain grouped; this does not justify bypassing local lifecycle or changing the API value type. No changed tests/assertions. Upstream1984401 API dependency remains private/bounded and unpaired; no engine records or required upstream support are public inputs. No certificate override, connection, send/reconnect, dialog, platform, UI/a11y or test/build/lint execution.",
        "Full retained Bug1984403 current0–2/updates/footer read. Description explicitly wants upstream1984401 API instead of duplicated error-code lists; exact spelling/input domain comes from comm source. Full D261976 creation-to-final timeline/summary read, no actual submitted inlines or summary history. Author delays review until upstream function lands; this supplies historical dependency intent, not a paired engine revision or independent service semantics. Approval/landing do not establish override behavior or test execution."
